tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ngan tshong ras pa'i rnam par thar pa'o//

"$ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ rje btsun ngan tshongs ras pa'i rnam thar la/ dang po yab de gsangs sngags rnying pa mkhan gcig yin pa la/ khong rang gis mnga' ris stod du slob gnyer la phyin pas/ tshad ma dang spyod phyogs dang*/ mdo 'grel mang du gsan te/ shes rab yang che bar byung ste/ legs par bslabs nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa gsum du gshegs sun du byed pa la/ yab yum 'das nas der gshegs sun chags nas dpe kun gung thang gi lha khang gcig tu phul nas/ skyo ba skyes nas rje btsun mi la brag dmar ling ba na bzhugs pa la gdams ngag zhus pas/ snod ldan du gzigs nas rje btsun ma'i brda'i byin rlabs dang*/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i brda' dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas/ yang snying bde mchog snyan rgyud rnams gnang*/ khyad par du lus med dha ki ma'i chos bskor dgu po lnga dar kar gyi yol ba'i nang nas gsungs pa/ bzhi po phyis ras chung bas phyis rgya gar nas byung nas lus med kyi chos skor bzhi po de/ bsre ba'i gdams pa khyad par can de rnams che ba ma byas par zhus skad do// de ltar mdzad nas/ rje mi la chen po la brten yun ring shing gdams pa khyad par can du 'phags pa mnga' ba'o// der rje ngan tshong ras pas rje btsun mi la la zhus/ rje btsun yis nyams su blangs pa la/ gtum mo la nyams kyi bye brag dang yon tan ci lta bu byung dris pa la/ brten nas nyams kyi gtum mo drin lan bcor ma dang*/ ma rigs gsal byed gnad kyi gzer bu gnyis gsungs so// de nas rje ngan tshong ras pas yang snyan rgyud la yi ger bkod do// de'i slob ma kham pa ngo khro tsang bzhed lags skad pa gcig byung bas/ yang zin ris byas gsungs/ de la kho bo'i slob ma la stod pa la ba can kyis zhus te mdor na rje btsun mi la'i bu chen brgyad kyi che shos yin pa'o// de la thugs kyi sras bzhi la/ gung thang gi mnyan chung ras pa/ lcim lung gi ngan tshong ras pa/

mdo bkra'i se ba ras pa/ dha mo'i 'bri sgom ras pa'o/ de dang nye ba'i sras brgyad la/ zhugs yas ras pa zhi ba 'od/ ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs/ ras pa tsas phu ba/ ras pa rdo rje dbang*/ gnyen sgom ras pa/ rong chung ras pa/ mkhar chung ras pa/ glan sgom ras pa dang brgyad do/ de rnams ni rje btsun mi la'i sku tshe stod kyi slob ma'o// sku tshe smad la/ thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras bzhi ste/ li gong bye ru ba/ 'or ston dge 'dun/ dam pa brgyag phu ba/ mnyam med rin po che dang bzhi ste/ rje ngan tshong ras pas dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhengs nas 'das te/ slob ma yang mang du bsnyin bar mdzad gsung ngo*// bdag gi bla ma la stod pa'i sku skye ba ding rir sku 'khrungs nas/ chung rgyun nas chos la dad pa gcig byung ste/ gdung rus pa ni glan yin gsungs/ de nas lo bcu gsum lon tsam na/ pha de shi nas ma des glang skor du yig rtsis slob tu bcugs/ de las lo bcu dgu lon tsam ma de yang shi/ nye ba gzhan gsha' ma med/ de nas da ni chos gcig bya dgos 'jig rten 'dis dgos pa med snyams pa sems la byung nas/ rgyal khams su bla ma gcig tshol dgos snyams nas phyin bas khong la la na re/ rje btsun mi la'i thugs zin che shos ngan tshong ras pa bya ba de da lta bal po rdzong gseb na bzhugs zer ba thos nas phyin bas/ rje ras pa chen po des thugs la btags nas/ 'phral gyi lto gos dang chos dang gsum ka gnangs nas/ lo lnga brten ba'i bar du bde mchog snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa rnams dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa rnams thugs la btags nas gnangs/ rtsang rong ngos pa gcig zhu shing 'dug pa la/ bsre ba'i skor dang*/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa dang*/ de rnams de gsha' ma mi gnang bar 'dug /de nas rje btsun de 'das pa'i dus su yang*/ gdung bzhus pas rnal 'byor ma'i sku byon/ nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i sgra snyan kyi bsu ba byung*/

de la sogs pa'i rtags mang po byung nas/ kho bo'i sems kyi spros pa gcad de/ bla ma de la sangs rgyas rang las gzhan gyi 'du shes skad cig tsam yang ma byung gsungs/ nga'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos yin par 'dug gsungs te/ phyi ma ngan bu ci tsug bgyi zhus pas/ bu snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pas ma chags shig /rnam rtog ye shes bde chen yin pas spang du med// 'khor 'das sems kyi snang ba yin pas logs na med// ci snang phyag rgya chen po yin pas bsgrub tu med// ces gsungs nas gshags so// des nas ngas kyang bsgrub pa rang bab zhig byas te/ ri khrod dang gangs khrod 'ba' zhig 'grims/ dgun phal cher yang bal po rdzong gseb tu bsdad/ dang po ras mang du gyon/ de nas phyis da ras de mngon mtshan che bar 'dug pas/ re ba'i gos kyang bag re gyon pa yin/ nga la 'jig rten pa'i snang ba 'di yi zang zing gis dgos pa med de/ rang dge sbyor ci 'phel byas/ rje btsun ngan tshong ras pa 'das nas/ phyi de lo de la khong 'das pa'i zla ba der song tsam na/ snying ma dga' ba gcig byung nas/ bla ma la ting 'dzin gyi pu tsa gcig phul nas gsol ba btabs pas/ bla ma rmi lam du byon nas rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs/ rje bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi byin gyis rlobs// bdag rtog med kyi rnal 'byor ras pa la// bu snying stobs can de gsol 'debs pa// sems gdung ba gcod pa'i glu 'di nyon/ khyod 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos thong la// rtse cig sems kyis bsgrub pa gyis// ma mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bar chod sel// rnam rtog gi bdud tshogs 'bros par 'gyur/ gnas ri khrod mtho ba 'grim tsam na/ yid skyo ba'i rlung gis bskyod gyur kyang*// bla ma la gsol ba rgyun du thob// byin rlabs kun shugs las 'byung bar 'gyur// mtsho ba'i mthun rkyen nyung ba na// bdud rtsi rtogs med kyi bcud len gyis// brgyag chu la gyis cig brtson 'grus can// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi 'tsho ba sbyor// rig pa bde gsal du shar tsam na// nyams bzang ngan la ma zhen rnal 'byor pa// rang byung gi ye shes chen po la// rang gzhan kyi don rnams rdzogs par 'gyur// de go'am rtogs sam skyes bu khyod// sems spros pa chod la nyams myong skyong*// zhes gsungs pas/

dus der snang ba 'di logs su grub pa mi 'dug /rang gi sems 'di gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin can du 'dug /gang la yang brtson 'grus dang re dogs bya rgyu med/ da rang gi sems 'di ye nas sangs rgyas gcig rang du 'dug snyams pa dang*/ gnyid sad tsam na/ sngar ma shar ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can gcig gting nas go nas 'dug ste/ blo dang bral ba'i lta ba gang gis kyang ma regs/ ma dmigs/ rtogs pa gcig go nas 'dug ste/ dus de nas ting nge 'dzin kyi ro la chags pa de yal/ rigs pa rang dngos su song nas 'dug gsung ngo*// de nas de bka' bzhin bla ma la gsol ba btabs shing ri khrod 'grims/ 'khor dang zang zing la dgos pa med pas ma bskyangs/ chos gcig pu 'di las med/ bla ma yang gcig pu de rang*/ snod ldan gyi gang zag byung na gdams ngag 'di gcig la sbyin snyam pa yin te/ khyod la sbyin pa 'di yin/ sngar ngas byin pa med/ da rung du yang gzhan sbyin snyam pa med/ da res khyed dang phrad pa de dga' ba gcig byung na ni tsa ri tsa kong de ltar phyin nas tshur log pa de don che/ khyed kyi 'gro ba sems can la phan thogs pa gcig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ da snyan rgyud 'di bka' rgya khrol ba yin te/ de skad gsungs nas bla ma dgung lo bdun cu don brgyad lon pa dang*/ rin chen gling pa dang 'phan yul rgyal du mjal tsa na/ yang sku lus shin tu bzang bar 'dug pa dang*/ da rung lo gcig gnyis thub re gsungs nas/ gdams pa rnams zhag bdun gyi bar la/ tsar kyi tshar bar gnang ba'o// gsang ba rin po che rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi skor/ rgya'i sdom bu ba bdag gis gdams ngag 'di dang phrad lugs ni/ dang po nas 'di la mos pa gcig yod pa la/ mkhas par shes pa ma byung*/ de nas slob dpon rin chen gling pa la zhus pas ma gnang nas/ khong gi slob ma khyung tshang ba'i lugs shes pa gcig la zhus de la skor drug tu bcas pa rgya che bar 'dug

/de'i lus med kyi chos zhus tsam na/ rmi lam gyi ltas khyad par can byung/ de nas snyal du phyin dus su/ tsang du 'gro tsam na/ rmi lam du rje mi la ras pa dpon slob gsum dang mjal nas/ nam mkha' na mar la gar thabs dang bcas nas// 'di skad gsungs/ kye rtogs par gyis gcig rnal 'byor pa// brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la// spros pa'i tshigs dang yi ge'i rgyan// don snyan rgyud brda yi dgongs pa de// rje bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs nas/ mi snang bar gyur to// de nas rje gung thang ba'i chags phyir phyin nas rje dang dam pa di ring mjal ba'i mdang gi rmi lam na/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la rje ri khrod dbang phyug nam mkha' la bzhugs pa mthong nas gsol ba btabs pa/ nam mkha' la gzigs dang gcig mdzad/ phyag yug yug mdzad nas/ kho rang nam mkha' la zhi nas sprin dngas pa bzhin song nas nga snyam nas/ de rnams brda ru 'dug don skye med nam mkha' lta bur shes par gyis gcig pa'i brdar go /de nas bla ma dang mjal bas/ khyod la kha zin zhag bdun gyi nub mo de ci 'dra ba gcig byung gsungs pas/ mos pa khyad par can skyes/ ri khrod pa'i brda dang phyi lus med dha ki ma'i chos dgu po'i brdar 'dug /ngas kyang bla ma de la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes/ bla ma de la dad gus byed gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ kho rang gi mtshan dris pas/ gsang mtshan 'dod chags rdo rje yin gsungs/ ma bshad gcig gsungs te grags pa ni/ la ba pa zhes grags so// de ltar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ bdag rang dang don grol byed las bstan par bya// ldom bu pa'i ban dhe yon tan bzang pos/ bla ma'i yon tan ci skad gsungs pa ltar yi ger bkod pa'o/// // /
